issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for concrete Animal subclasses (Seal, Pig, Goat). The template's Main.java contains commented example instantiations using two-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")) which implies the subclasses require two parameters. The problem statement UML and the reference solution define Animal and its concrete subclasses with a single 'name' attribute and single-parameter constructors (e.g., Seal(String name)). This inconsistency can mislead students about required constructor signatures and which attributes they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the example usages in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java consistent with the UML and intended design by using single-parameter constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle"), new Pig("Doodle"), new Goat("Buttinsky")). If a second attribute was intended, instead update the problem statement and reference solution to declare that additional attribute and provide matching two-argument constructors and tests.
